evals.prompt: Review a PR after CI forced a code pivot. Earlier review and tests passed before the latest commit.
evals.expected_output: Review must fail stale evidence for affected files, re-check the current final diff, map contract PCs to implementation and tests, and require fresh proof before PASS.
assertions: Rejects pre-pivot review evidence.
Reviews current final diff.
Maps every PC to implementation and test evidence.
Checks runtime execution proof for changed files.

evals.prompt: Review a change that modifies a query and a browser PDF upload path.
evals.expected_output: Review must require current code reads, live/integration DB proof for query behavior, headless browser proof for upload/preview/download, repo gate evidence, structured attack lens packet evidence with agent/session/receipt proof, and adversarial lenses for non-trivial risk. Delegated lenses should use Codex headless by default after MCP preflight.
assertions: Requires live DB proof, not mocks/migrations/diffs.
Requires headless browser proof for UI/PDF flow.
Checks repo gate matrix evidence and structured attack lens packet evidence with agent/session/receipt proof.
Uses Codex headless as the default delegated lens runtime when delegation is available.
Labels independent or multi-lens review limitations.

evals.prompt: Review a PR that changes invoice SQL and PDF upload UI. The PR is already open, Copilot is slow, and the user does not want to wait on non-blocking comments.
evals.expected_output: Review must classify the lane as high-risk, require draft or an explicit open-PR exception with gate evidence, and route Copilot comments through advisory-harvest instead of making them default merge blockers.
assertions: Classifies PR mode as high-risk-draft or a justified open-PR exception.
Does not require waiting indefinitely for non-blocking Copilot comments.
Routes useful Copilot comments to fix, follow-up, trap, gate, contract/plan rule, or eval.
Escalates advisory comments if they indicate schema, tenant, security, money/order/invoice/inventory, or user-visible correctness risk.

evals.prompt: Review a refactor that extracted a one-call adapter and exported three private helpers only so tests can call them.
evals.expected_output: Review must apply architecture-depth checks: deletion test, interface-depth test, locality/leverage, seam reality, and public-seam test surface. It should fail or require justification for pass-through modules and private-helper exports.
assertions: Applies the deletion test to new or modified modules.
Checks whether the interface hides more complexity than it exposes.
Flags one-adapter hypothetical seams unless an external-boundary reason exists.
Flags private helper exports used only for test reachability.

evals.prompt: Review a current diff with green tests, but the implementation no longer proves the operator acceptance from the original vague request, touched a mixed service without the fix-now SRP refactor, and added a SELECT report outside the owning reader seam.
evals.expected_output: Review must fail spec compliance. It must require the Intent Continuity Ledger to prove original user words, business outcome, operator acceptance, and non-goals; require the touched-file SRP fix-now action or a contract-backed blocker/narrowed claim; and require DB/query ownership proof for the SELECT report, including owner seam, scope predicates, readback expectation, bounded proof, cleanup, and current DB/schema evidence.
assertions: Fails green tests that do not prove the original operator acceptance.
Fails skipped fix-now SRP/refactor work on a mixed-responsibility touched file.
Fails read-only SELECT/report query ownership bypasses.
Requires current-code and proof evidence, not plan prose.
Classifies these gaps as review failures rather than advisory polish.

evals.prompt: Review a green PR that changes product workbench UI state, Shopify read health, live-proof registry patterns, and proof artifacts. Recent dev PRs had reviewer comments for stale state, unlinked products shown unavailable, regex lane misses, weak assertions, and stale proof subjects.
evals.expected_output: Review must build a current trap bank from PR threads plus recent dev evidence, replay every applicable row against the current final diff, and fail PASS if rows are only broadly asserted or covered by stale/pre-pivot evidence.
assertions: Builds or refreshes a review feedback trap bank from current PR threads and recent merged PR evidence.
Replays stale UI state, outage semantics, proof-lane, weak assertion, proof-subject, DB/query ownership, integration fault, redaction, and SRP/domain rows where applicable.
Requires current-head source evidence and command proof for each applicable trap row.
Fails review when a row is probably covered only by broad tests or stale evidence.
Routes missing prevention rows back to contract/build rather than treating them as advisory polish.
